# Global submissions map

- D3 7.9.0: https://github.com/d3/d3 (ISC license; see D3-LICENSE).
- TopoJSON Client 3.1.0: https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client (ISC license; see TOPOJSON-LICENSE).
- World Atlas 2.0.2 countries-110m.json: https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas (ISC license). Boundaries are derived from public-domain Natural Earth 1:110m geographic data: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/.
- Country matching uses ISO 3166-1 numeric identifiers, with alternate-name matching for common aliases.
- Small-territory markers use longitude, latitude in degrees: Hong Kong [114.1694, 22.3193], Turks and Caicos Islands [-71.7979, 21.694], Singapore [103.8198, 1.3521], Qatar [51.1839, 25.3548], United Arab Emirates [53.8478, 23.4241]. Other markers use spherical centroids of the corresponding country boundaries.
- Submission counts are provided by CAEP and stored only in assets/submissions-2026.json. They total 183 across 34 geographic entries. This historical map is independent of the existing Final Round statistics.
- The historical category count (4) and preliminary advancement count (59) are supplied by CAEP in the map implementation request.
